name: Football
description: The world's game: the clubs, the World Cups and the players, from the first rules in 1863 to Messi and Ronaldo.

checkpoints.name: The first clubs
checkpoints.note: Sheffield F.C. is the oldest club, and the Football Association fixes the laws of association football in 1863. Clubs such as Arsenal, Celtic, Rangers, Liverpool, Manchester United and Juventus grow out of factories, churches and schools. FIFA is set up in 1904.

checkpoints.name: The World Cup begins
checkpoints.note: Uruguay hosts and wins the first World Cup in 1930. Real Madrid, FC Barcelona and AC Milan build strong sides, Boca Juniors and Santos grow in South America, Brazil's national team becomes football's most famous side, and in 1950 the Maracana stadium holds a record crowd.

checkpoints.name: The Pelé era
checkpoints.note: A young Pelé wins the 1958 World Cup. The old Wembley Stadium sees England win in 1966, Brazil triumphs in Mexico in 1970, and Johan Cruyff's Ajax and the Dutch bring Total Football. Benfica and Bayern Munich rise in the European Cup, later the Champions League.

checkpoints.name: Maradona and the Premier League
checkpoints.note: Maradona's 1986 World Cup is a landmark, the Ballon d'Or lists the best players, and Hillsborough forces stadiums to change. The Premier League is formed in 1992 and television money reshapes the sport.

checkpoints.name: Messi and Ronaldo
checkpoints.note: Messi and Ronaldo dominate the Ballon d'Or, El Clásico draws a global audience, and the 2002 and 2022 World Cups show football reaching Asia and the Middle East. The Champions League becomes the club game's grandest stage.
